Main.title: What is DroMii?
Main.description: DroMii captures and analyzes spatial data using drones and AI.
Main.description2: A GeoAI platform that transforms aerial data into actionable insights.
Main.description3:
Drone-based data collection is faster and more efficient than traditional surveying. 
DroMii automatically analyzes captured data to deliver spatial insights for roads, environment, and infrastructure. 
Results can be accessed and shared instantly via URL without installing any software.

Platform.description:
The DroMii platform turns drone imagery into powerful spatial intelligence using AI. 
From data capture to analysis and sharing, everything happens in one platform.
Platform.DaaS:
Automatically generate
3D models, panoramas, and spatial insights
from drone imagery and share them instantly via URL.
Platform.DTM:
AI-powered image analysis extracts
road and infrastructure data automatically
and supports condition monitoring and system integration.
Platform.CfSM:
Deep learning removes vehicles
from road imagery to generate
high-precision car-free road data.
Platform.AfGG:
AI detects and labels
road markings and key objects
to generate high-precision road safety maps.

Advantages.Convenient:
DroMii builds spatial intelligence from drone-generated 3D models and panoramic data. 
Analysis results and reports are delivered via URL, enabling instant access anywhere. 
With simple drag-and-drop uploads, users can generate 3D spatial data in minutes.
Advantages.Automation:
The DroMii platform automates the entire processing pipeline through distributed cloud computing. 
Automatic mosaicking, color correction, and panoramic generation are performed seamlessly, 
and HTML5-based results can be accessed from any device or operating system.
Advantages.DeepLearning:
DroMii combines drone data with advanced AI technologies to deliver powerful infrastructure analytics. 
Deep learning models automatically remove vehicles from road imagery 
and generate high-precision car-free road data for advanced spatial analysis.
